# U22: MCP access: an admin gives a teammate an MCP token, then revokes it; a builder token made before is labelled apart

- **Belongs to:** the AI access module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `MCP-TOKENS`
- **Budget:** at most 10 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As no one chosen yet, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U22

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser, with no one chosen yet.
- _Note:_ A real-app workspace (kept in the browser for the evals), copied from the example, with Amara as the admin.
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The page’s heading area shows.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `async () => { const full = await window.__goalsStore.load('platform-org'); // One builder token made before the inbox opened (backlog 10a): it works as an ordinary one and is labelled apart. const builder = { id: 'tok_builder', personId: 'amara', name: 'Inbox on my phone', createdBy: 'amara', createdAt: '2026-11-01T09:00:00Z', lastUsedAt: null, revokedAt: null, builder: true }; const ex = { ...full, tokens: [builder], changes: [], checkIns: full.checkIns.filter((c) => c.week >= 42) }; localStorage.setItem('goals-live-v1:workspaces', JSON.stringify([{ id: 'ws_live', name: 'Platform', kind: 'own', createdAt: '2026-09-01T00:00:00Z' }])); localStorage.setItem('goals-live-v1:ws_live', JSON.stringify(ex)); localStorage.setItem('goals-live-workspace', 'ws_live'); localStorage.setItem('goals-live-me:ws_live', 'amara'); }`.
- Go to `/workspace/ai` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- _Note:_ An admin setting, further down the Workspace page: 'entry' is judged on everyday journeys, not this one.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `/A token lets Claude or another AI tool act as one person here/.test(await p.locator('.access-tokens').innerText()) && /builder token/.test(await p.locator('.access-tokens').getByText('Inbox on my phone').first().innerText())`. Else it says: MCP tokens do not say what they are, or do not label the builder token apart.
- **Step.** Press the “Make a token” button.
- Press the “Who it acts as: …Change” button in a dialog.
- Type “Mateo” into a search field in a dialog.
- Press the “Mateo Fernández” option in a dialog.
- **Check:** (`errors`) the “Make the token” button in a dialog is disabled (else: a token can be made without saying what it is for).
- **Step.** Type “Claude on Mateo’s laptop” into the “What it’s for” field in a dialog.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “make token”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Make the token” button in a dialog.
- **Check:** “it isn’t shown again” is shown.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `/^gk_[A-Za-z0-9]{40}$/.test(token) && (await dlg.getByLabel('Claude Code command').inputValue()).includes('/api/mcp')`, where `const dlg = p.getByRole('dialog')`; `const token = await dlg.getByLabel('Token').inputValue()`. Else it says: the token or the connection command is missing.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “token”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Done” button in a dialog.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('goals-live-v1:ws_live')).tokens.filter((t) => !t.builder)`.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `stored.length === 1 && stored[0].tokenHash === hash && stored[0].personId === 'mateo' && !JSON.stringify(stored).includes(token)`, where `const dlg = p.getByRole('dialog')`; `const token = await dlg.getByLabel('Token').inputValue()`; `const stored = await p.evaluate(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('goals-live-v1:ws_live')).tokens.filter((t) => !t.builder))`; `const hash = await p.evaluate(async (t) => [...new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(t)))].map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join(''), token)`. Else it says: the token was stored in plain text, or not at all.
- **Check:** “not used yet” is shown.
- **Step.** Press the “Revoke Claude on Mateo’s laptop” button.
- **Check:** “Revoked” is shown.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('goals-live-v1:ws_live')).tokens.filter((t) => !t.builder)`.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `!!after[0].revokedAt`, where `const after = await p.evaluate(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('goals-live-v1:ws_live')).tokens.filter((t) => !t.builder))`. Else it says: the token was not revoked.
- **Check:** (`progress`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
